entry.title: WCAG 3.0’s Proposed Scoring Model: A Shift In Accessibility Evaluation
entry.summary: WCAG is evolving. Since 1999, the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines have defined accessibility in binary terms: either a success criterion is met or not. Could this be the start of a new era in accessibility?
